profile.headline: Software Engineer 2 at Microsoft
profile.summary: Experienced Software Development Manager with a Top Secret clearance with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry, particularly DOD and USPS projects. Strong engineering professional skilled in Oracle Database, Web Design, Java, Coldfusion, Networking, and HTML.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
•	Manage developers and train them in coding practices, standards, and processes. Assign developer tasks from clients or internal team.
•	Lead development, support, and other tasks relating for client.
•	Provide backup support for CM, DBA, and SA
•	Point of contacts between team and CACI on-site support at the client for issues, enhancements and requirements.
•	Analyze and mitigate security issues in the code such as SQL Injection, Cross Site Scripting, etc
•	Mitigate security issues from Fortify Scan
•	Review developer’s code
•	Develops, codes, tests, and debugs new software or enhancements to existing project that is over 20 years old. 
•	Develop source codes with Eclipse using Coldfusion, HTML, jQuery, JavaScript, and PL/SQL
•	Utilize Mashups as versions control software, Serena as bugs and requirements software
•	Develop new features from the client requirements
•	Derive technical requirements and create technical documents for new requirements
•	Provide in-depth help to testers for smooth and easier testing 
•	Provide support and logs client issues using Serena
•	Assist testers in automated testing using Selenium
•	Provide efficient and top-quality codes

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Develops, codes, tests, and debugs new software or enhancements to existing project 
•	Develop source codes with Eclipse using Java, Coldfusion, HTML, JQUERY, JavaScript, and PL/SQL
•	Develop new features from the client requirements
•	Develop software base on client input and dynamic requirements
•	Provide efficient and top quality codes with minimal supervisions
•	Migrate legacy contracted applications to internal systems

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Designed and developed new requirements from the client for an existing system. Maintain existing codes by identifying, tracking, troubleshooting, and resolving issues. Analyze, track and resolve issues with databases. Also provide expertise and knowledge to new developers and team members. Provide ongoing support for the system in Production server.  

•	Primary developer for the project, currently the developer with the most knowledge on legacy system
•	Work independently as well as a team member in performing project application design and development
•	Full stack developer working with front end and back end development, assisting with database server issues, and Websphere Coldfusion server issues
•	Develop source codes with IBM RAD using Java, Coldfusion, HTML, Javascript, AJAX, XML, and PL/SQL
•	Able to derive technical requirements from high level direction and adapt quickly
•	Analysis, design, development, and testing of source codes 
•	Utilize Subversions as version control software
•	Maintain legacy system by providing troubleshoot and production support to client
•	Assist and provides support in production deployments
•	Analyze legacy codes to ascertain business logic and code logic for the system
•	Analyze Oracle 10g/11g database to create mapping of tables with Oracle Developer Data Modeler 
•	Provide support and knowledge to other developers on the system

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Receive a month-long training course in Java. Write test conditions and implements them in Java for automated tests as a Test Engineer. Also logs and track the various issues using required software. 

•	Took four weeks Java Fundamental Training course
•	Write test conditions, scripts, and automated tests as Test Engineer utilizing Selenium
•	Develop source code with Eclipse using Java and execute scripts using Jenkins
•	Execute test scripts and document results
•	Log defects using Quality Center
•	Apply testing and defect management processes
•	Aid team in tracking, documenting and communicating various items
•	Took over as engineer for developing, maintain, and fixing of automated test scripts
•	Provide programming help to other testers in Java

volunteerExperiences.description:
Help kids and teenager with school work and technology.
Watch children in a youth center. Chaperone children on trips and play time.
